cases: publish claim: after original owned directory moved to backup, create empty destination just before new.rename; require refusal and claimant same dev/inode/empty content
rollback claim: same point, create empty destination then raise controlled EIO without publishing; require claimant same dev/inode/empty content after attempted rollback
normal replacement control: no injected claim/fault; new content present
uncontended EIO rollback control: error before publication; original prior inode and content restored
injection: Patch pathlib.Path.rename only when source.name==new and target==owned destination, delegate every other rename to saved real method; claim via realmkdir, fault via EIO. Four isolated temporary-directory cases; no multiprocess/stress/frequency claims. No source edits.
